info.name: Palo Alto Networks Strata Logging Service API
info.description:
Strata Logging Service API (formerly Cortex Data Lake) for log forwarding configuration management. Provides programmatic control over log forwarding profiles and their destinations including syslog servers, HTTPS endpoints, and email recipients. Enables centralized management of where SASE and NGFW log data is forwarded for SIEM integration, compliance archival, and security operations workflows.

Contact Support:
 Name: Palo Alto Networks Developer Support
